articles.title: U.S. and China Set Up AI Hotline After Three-Day Summit
articles.summary: After a three-day summit in Washington, the U.S. and China agreed to create a hotline for AI incidents and keep talking about trade and their militaries. No huge breakthroughs, but experts say the new working groups matter.

articles.title: Trump Rolls Back Biden-Era Fuel Economy Rules, Calling Them an 'EV Mandate'
articles.summary: President Trump announced new fuel economy standards that undo Biden-era rules requiring cars to average about 50.4 mpg by 2031. He says it will lower prices, but critics worry about pollution and falling behind on EVs.

articles.title: Nor'easter Floods Northeast, Cancels Flights and Concerts
articles.summary: A powerful nor'easter flooded New York and New Jersey, forcing states of emergency and cutting power to over 100,000 homes. More than 3,600 flights were delayed or canceled, and events from football to concerts were called off.
